evidence: the C entry of test.bin (its address is the word _start jumps through at 0x0C0200A8): runs hardware_boot (0x0C020240) and game_boot (0x0C020380), then game_frame_loop (0x0C020500, which never returns) and the two empty tails game_main_tail_a / game_main_tail_b; returns 0; the test.bin build of main.bin's game_main (0x0C0200C0), without main.bin's argument keeping and game_loop_enter; reached only from _start; part of testmode/testmode.c (see notes)

test-mode start-up, first half: clears system_param_value (0x58 bytes) and sets its byte 0 to 1 (main.bin's clears it to 0; network_mode_text later reads this word as the "(TEST)" / "(GAME)" choice), sys_bring_up_vectors_timer, board_prestart, keeps the board record pointer (FUN_0c04d1e0) at 0x0C345788 and copies its first 20 bytes to system_param_value +0x14, naomi2_lib_start (mode 9 when the record's word +0x0C is 0), sys_bring_up_buses, board_start, input_init, irq_slots_install_naomi, tmu0_restart_usec_scale, mtx_stacks_start (0x0C344B48, 32 deep), FUN_0c04ba40(1, 0), display_init, text_overlay_setup, text_newline_keeps_margin and 16x16 text; the test.bin build of main.bin's hardware_boot (0x0C0202A0); only caller game_main; part of testmode/testmode.c

test-mode start-up, second half: system_param_country_init, media_probe_and_ids, user_back_init, sffs_mount, dimm_files_init, player_input_init, test_menu_start, net_init(1) (FUN_0c028640), then the network check: up to the backup's time-out count (word +8 of 0x0C302048; 2 when net_is_on is 0) passes of net_check_step, each drawing "% 4d / %d" at cell (5, 15) and running FUN_0c0312a0, alab_step_timed (FUN_0c0297e0) with the G1 bus held, and test_frame_finish; finally net_log_status_write(net_is_on(), 1, passes, limit); the test.bin build of main.bin's game_boot (0x0C020420), which has the same "% 4d / %d" check loop; only caller game_main; part of testmode/testmode.c
empty routine game_main calls after game_frame_loop (never reached: the loop is endless); the test.bin build of main.bin's game_main_tail_a (0x0C0208A0); role unclear; part of testmode/testmode.c
empty routine game_main calls after game_main_tail_a (never reached); the test.bin build of main.bin's game_main_tail_b (0x0C0208C0); role unclear; part of testmode/testmode.c

the endless test-mode frame loop: each pass waits for G1 DMA (g1_dma_spin_idle), sram_bank_snapshot(0x0C300008), loads the identity matrix, reads the I/O (input_read, input_per_frame), runs the current test screen (test_screen_run), flushes the backup (user_back_flush), when the network is on (net_is_on) polls the network test reply (net_test_reply_poll_pending) and runs FUN_0c0312a0, ends the frame (test_frame_finish) and adds 1 to test_frame_count; the test.bin build of main.bin's game_frame_loop (0x0C0208E0); only caller game_main; part of testmode/testmode.c

reads every I/O board (jvs_node_input_read) or, without one, only the board switches (board_switch_bits) and latches them; the test.bin build of main.bin's input_read (0x0C0487E0), same instructions; only caller game_frame_loop (main.bin runs it from the V-blank hook); part of vf4lib/libbase/src/input.c
